name: DL-2,3,6-trimethoxyamphetamine
summary: 2,3,6-Trimethoxyamphetamine (2,3,6-TMA), also known as TMA-5, is a psychedelic drug and mild stimulant of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families. It is one of the possible positional isomers of trimethoxyamphetamine and is a positional isomer of 3,4,5-trimethoxyamphetamine (TMA or TMA-1).

pharmacology.text: Unlike the other TMA isomers, 2,3,6-TMA was not tested at serotonin receptors or in rodent drug discrimination tests.

uses.en: It is a little-known research chemical, described by Shulgin in PiHKAL, with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是一種鮮為人知的研究用化學品，由舒爾金記載於《PiHKAL》，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种鲜为人知的研究用化学品，由舒尔金记载于《PiHKAL》，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelic amphetamines of its family can cause nausea, a raised heart rate, anxiety and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的影響所知甚少。同家族的迷幻安非他命類可能造成噁心、心跳加快、焦慮與意識混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的影响所知甚少。同家族的迷幻安非他命类可能造成恶心、心跳加快、焦虑与意识混乱。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin listed it as TMA-5 in PiHKAL. There are six ways to arrange three methoxy groups on the ring of amphetamine, and he numbered them TMA to TMA-6.
fact.zh: 亞歷山大．舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中將它列為TMA-5。三個甲氧基在安非他命苯環上的排列方式共有六種，他將其編號為TMA至TMA-6。
fact.zhHans: 亚历山大．舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中将它列为TMA-5。三个甲氧基在安非他命苯环上的排列方式共有六种，他将其编号为TMA至TMA-6。
